notes:
The twist this year is called Tathas-two: every housemate begins with two lives, and an eviction or a twist costs one of them. That means a vote-out does not always end a stay, as Uditi found on Day 6.

It started on 6 September 2026 with the grand premiere, hosted by Salman Khan. The last place in the house went to Love Gill after viewers picked her over Rhiya Ahir in the Fans Ka Faisla vote; Rhiya was not chosen and was out before the season began.

Week one was about captaincy. Kanika Mann was asked to name the housemate she liked least and chose Qazi Touqeer, who was then kept out of the captaincy task. Aasif, Gullu and Yung DSA became the nominees, and Yung DSA won the captaincy on Day 4. Arishfa, Kanika, Love and Uditi were nominated on Day 3, and Uditi was voted out on Day 6, losing a life.

In week two, Bigg Boss cancelled the nominations the housemates had made and named Aasif, Rohed and Scout directly for talking about nominations. Rohed was evicted through public voting on Day 14.

Based on the latest update we have (22 September 2026, about two and a half weeks in), Isha and Yung DSA are up for eviction. This page is updated as the season airs.

people.name: Kanika Mann
people.known_for: Television actress from Panipat, known for Guddan Tumse Na Ho Payega
people.overview:
Kanika Mann was born on 7 October 1993 in Panipat, Haryana, and studied at Panjab University in Chandigarh. Her path into acting ran through modelling and Punjabi music videos before her first film, the Punjabi title Rocky Mental, in 2017. A Kannada film, Brihaspathi, followed in 2018.

Television is where most viewers know her. She debuted on the small screen in 2018 with Badho Bahu, playing Titli opposite Prince Narula, and then spent 2018 to 2020 as Guddan in Guddan Tumse Na Ho Payega, the role that made her a household name. She made her web debut in 2022 with Roohaniyat, and the same year reached the finale of Khatron Ke Khiladi 12.

Inside the Bigg Boss 20 house, her first act came before she had unpacked: on Day 0 Bigg Boss asked her to watch her housemates and name the one she liked least. On Day 2 she named Qazi Touqeer, who was then kept out of the captaincy task. She was also among the four housemates nominated in the first eviction round, on Day 3, and she remains in the house at the time of writing.

faq.q: What is Kanika Mann best known for?
faq.a: Playing Guddan in the television serial Guddan Tumse Na Ho Payega between 2018 and 2020.

faq.q: Has Kanika Mann been on a reality show before?
faq.a: Yes. She was a finalist on Khatron Ke Khiladi 12 in 2022.

people.name: Aasif Khan
people.known_for: Actor best known as Babar in Mirzapur and for Panchayat
people.overview:
Aasif Khan grew up in Nimbahera, a small town in Chittorgarh district, Rajasthan, where he was born on 13 March 1991. He first tried acting at a school event in 2001 and won a local stand-up contest, but his father's death in 2008 put those plans on hold and he took whatever work he could find.

In 2010 he moved to Mumbai. He worked as a waiter in a hotel and later in a mall while going to auditions, played tiny parts as a junior artist in films including Ready and Agneepath, and then trained in theatre in Jaipur from 2011, performing on stage for around five years. That slow route led to Mirzapur (2018 to 2020), where his role as Babar became his best-known work, and to Panchayat.

In the house he was one of the three captaincy nominees on Day 2, alongside Gullu and Yung DSA. On Day 8 Bigg Boss stepped in and nominated him, with Rohed and Scout, for eviction after the housemates were found to be talking about nominations, which the house rules forbid.

facts.value: Theatre in Jaipur, after years as a junior artist in Mumbai

faq.a: Babar in the web series Mirzapur, and a part in Panchayat.

people.name: Qazi Touqeer
people.known_for: Singer from Srinagar who won Fame Gurukul in 2005
people.overview:
Qazi Touqeer, born in Srinagar on 4 June 1986, became known across India in 2005 when he won Fame Gurukul, Sony's singing reality show modelled on the international Fame Academy format. He shared the title with Ruprekha Banerjee. Arijit Singh was also a contestant that season and finished sixth, a detail that resurfaced when Qazi entered Bigg Boss 20.

He sings in Kashmiri, Hindi and Urdu and had no formal training before the show. His win was widely celebrated in the Kashmir Valley and the two winners released an album at the end of 2005. He later prepared for an acting debut in a film called Take Off, and was injured in a fall at a rehearsal studio.

In Bigg Boss 20 he became the centre of an early moment in the house: on Day 2, Kanika Mann was asked by Bigg Boss to name the housemate she disliked most and picked him, which kept him out of the captaincy task. He acted as the task's sanchalak, the person who runs it, instead.

faq.q: What did Qazi Touqeer win?
faq.a: Fame Gurukul in 2005, sharing the title with Ruprekha Banerjee.

faq.q: What happened to Qazi in the first week of Bigg Boss 20?
faq.a: Kanika Mann named him as the housemate she disliked most, so he was not allowed to take part in the captaincy task and ran it as sanchalak.

people.name: Isha Rikhi
people.known_for: Punjabi and Hindi film actress and model
people.overview:
Isha Rikhi is an actress and model who began in Punjabi cinema, with a debut in Jatt Boys Putt Jattan De (2013), followed by films including Bade Changay Ne Mere Yaar Kaminey, What the Jatt and Ardaas (2016). She moved into Hindi films in 2018 with Nawabzaade.

She came into Bigg Boss 20 at a point when her personal life was already in the news. In 2026 she married the rapper Badshah, and on 31 August the two announced that the marriage had ended after about five months. She joined the show about a week later. Asked why, she told The Indian Express that she had always been a private person and wanted viewers to see the different sides of her.

As of the latest update we have, she is one of the housemates up for eviction.

faq.q: Why did Isha Rikhi join Bigg Boss 20?
faq.a: She told The Indian Express she had been very private and wanted people to know more about her.

faq.a: Nawabzaade, in 2018.

people.name: Amrapali Dubey
people.known_for: One of the best-known actresses in Bhojpuri cinema
people.overview:
Amrapali Dubey was born on 11 January 1987 in the Gorakhpur district of Uttar Pradesh and moved to Mumbai, where she finished her education at Bhavan's College. She began in television with Saat Phere: Saloni Ka Safar in 2009 and went on to roles in Maayka and Rehna Hai Teri Palkon Ki Chhaon Mein.

Her big shift came in 2014, when she entered Bhojpuri films with Nirahua Hindustani. Later titles, among them Nirahua Hindustani 2, Border, Sher Singh and Aashiqui, made her one of the leading actresses in that industry, and she is often listed among its highest paid. She is also known for her on-screen pairing with Dinesh Lal Yadav. She has won four Bhojpuri Film Awards and two International Bhojpuri Film Awards.

She is one of the 16 housemates who entered Bigg Boss 20 at the grand premiere on 6 September 2026.

people.name: Love Gill
people.known_for: Punjabi actress and model who entered through the Fans Ka Faisla vote
people.overview:
Love Gill, whose full name is Lovepreet Kaur Gill, is an actress and model from Punjabi cinema. The Times of India traces her rise to a role in Karan Aujla's music video Facts, and she has since appeared in the Punjabi films Tu Patang Main Dor and Kuriyan Jawan Bapu Pare.

Her way into Bigg Boss 20 was different from the others. In the weeks before the show, viewers voted through the JioHotstar app in a Fans Ka Faisla campaign to choose between her and Rhiya Ahir for the final place. At the grand premiere on 6 September 2026, host Salman Khan announced that Love had been picked, while Rhiya was out before the season began.

On Day 3 she was one of four housemates nominated in the first eviction round, together with Arishfa, Kanika and Uditi.

Yung DSA is the stage name of Harsh Vijay Machare, a rapper and digital creator from Pune. Pune Mirror describes his style as desi hip-hop, and the track people most often connect with him is Yeda Yung. Pune Mirror writes that the city's hip-hop scene has found a new spotlight on national television through him.

people.name: Mary Kom
people.known_for: Six-time world champion boxer and Olympic bronze medallist
people.overview:
Mary Kom is among the most decorated boxers India has produced. She is the only woman to have won the World Amateur Boxing Championship six times and the only boxer, of either sex, to have won eight World Championship medals. She is nicknamed Magnificent Mary.

At the 2012 Summer Olympics she was India's only female boxer and won a bronze medal in the flyweight (51 kg) category. Outside the ring she has served as a member of the Rajya Sabha, the upper house of India's Parliament.

Her name was among those widely rumoured before the season began, and she entered at the grand premiere on 6 September 2026 as one of the housemates from the world of sport.

Since then she has worked across television and music videos and built an online following that India Today put at 29 million followers when she joined, one of the biggest of the season.

She was among the four housemates put up for eviction on Day 3. Aasif also named her on Day 3 as the housemate whose lifeline he would take if he became captain.

people.name: Mahhi Vij
people.known_for: Television actress, Laagi Tujhse Lagan and Balika Vadhu
people.overview:
Mahhi Vij was born on 1 April 1982, moved to Mumbai at 17 and started as a model, appearing in music videos before television. Her breakthrough was playing Nakusha in Laagi Tujhse Lagan on Colors TV, which won her the Gold Award for Best Actress in a Lead Role in 2011. In 2016 she played Nandini Shekhawat in Balika Vadhu.

She is also a reality show regular. She and her then husband Jay Bhanushali won Nach Baliye 5, and she took part in Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa 4 and Khatron Ke Khiladi 7. After a break of about nine years she returned to acting in December 2025 with Seher: Hone Ko Hai, and left the series in May 2026. The couple divorced in 2026.

She entered Bigg Boss 20 at the grand premiere on 6 September 2026.
